# Customer response

Use only facts present in the supplied context.

1. Open with the direct answer.
2. Separate confirmed facts from assumptions.
3. Give every action an owner and due date.
4. Never invent a customer commitment, quote, or delivery date.
5. End with the single decision or input needed next.
